summary: Verified the auth autoCapitalize bug fix (app/auth.tsx & app/forgot-password.tsx) via full functional regression on web preview (mobile viewport 390x844). All 6 requested steps PASS. Registration, login with same password, forgot-password flow (code retrieved from backend logs), login with reset password, and existing-user regression login all succeeded with no errors.
action_items: No action needed - fix verified working. Optional: consider adding a native-mobile (real device/Expo Go) manual check at some point since Playwright's web software-keyboard emulation cannot reproduce OS-level autoCapitalize-on-touch-keyboard timing bugs; the code-level fix (autoCapitalize='none'/autoCorrect={false}/spellCheck={false}/textContentType) is the correct and sufficient mitigation and is confirmed present in both files.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.tsx password field: autoCapitalize='none', autoCorrect={false}, spellCheck={false}, textContentType set correctly (newPassword on register, password on login). Confirmed via DOM attribute check (autocapitalize='none').
forgot-password.tsx reset-password-new-password-input: same props confirmed present (autoCapitalize='none', autoCorrect={false}, spellCheck={false}, textContentType='newPassword').
Email fields on both screens still correctly have autoCapitalize='none' (unchanged, confirmed via DOM attribute = 'none').
No backend changes required/made; bcrypt/JWT logic untouched, consistent with root cause being purely a TextInput prop issue.

seed_data_creation: Created test user qatest2026_1793548996@test.pl (password reset from 'qatest2026pass' to 'newpass2026x' during test). Left in DB as test artifact; not a real/protected account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test flow note: the app gates /profile (and its logout button) behind quiz completion (has_profile), so a brand-new registered user cannot reach the UI logout button without completing a 10-question quiz. To simulate 'logout' for auth regression testing, I cleared both localStorage AND all IndexedDB databases (AsyncStorage's web shim backs onto IndexedDB, not localStorage, per comment in src/utils/storage/index.web.ts) and reloaded - this reliably returns the app to the /auth screen. Plain localStorage.clear() alone is NOT sufficient on web and will leave the session active.
rca_of_issue: Step-by-step results: (1) Registered qatest2026_<ts>@test.pl with password 'qatest2026pass', country PL -> PASS (landed on /quiz, no error). (2) Cleared storage (sim. logout), logged back in with identical password 'qatest2026pass' -> PASS (landed on /quiz, no auth-error shown) - confirms core regression (autoCapitalize='none' did not break normal login). (3) Forgot-password flow: requested code for the test email, found code in backend logs via grep: 'password reset code for qatest2026_...@test.pl: 432732' (/var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log), entered code + new password 'newpass2026x', submitted -> PASS (landed on /quiz, no error, auto-logged-in via completeAuth). (4) Cleared storage again, logged in with the NEW password 'newpass2026x' -> PASS (landed on /quiz, no error) - this is the critical check that was reportedly broken before the fix (reset not fixing lockout); confirmed working now. (5) Regression login for existing seeded user ania_t1@test.pl / test123 -> PASS (landed on home/careers tab '/' with pre-existing profile data visible, e.g. 'Zawody dla Ciebie', confirming existing accounts unaffected). (6) Verified via DOM attribute inspection that auth-email-input has autocapitalize='none' (unchanged) and auth-password-input also now has autocapitalize='none' (the fix). All steps pass; fix appears correctly implemented and does not regress existing functionality.
